name: Daytona Computers
description: Run sessions in Daytona cloud sandboxes.

provider.label: Daytona sandbox
provider.description: A Linux sandbox in Daytona's cloud (or your self-hosted Daytona). Stops with its disk when idle.

schema.label: Daytona API key
schema.description: From app.daytona.io. DAYTONA_API_KEY is also read.

schema.label: Snapshot
schema.description: Optional snapshot name. Empty uses Daytona's default image.

schema.label: Stop after idle (minutes)
schema.description: Daytona's own idle timer, used only when Recursive is asleep or closed and can't stop the sandbox itself. The disk is kept, so work in progress is handed in when the sandbox starts again. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: Monthly spending cap (USD)
schema.description: Auto stops starting Daytona sandboxes once their estimated cost this month reaches this amount, and runs sessions on your computers or another sandbox provider instead. Enter an amount such as 50, or unlimited.

schema.label: Cost per sandbox hour (USD)
schema.description: Used to estimate spending: each sandbox counts from when it starts until it is deleted. An estimate for the default size; set it to your plan's price.

schema.label: Delete idle sandboxes after (hours)
schema.description: The hard limit for any Daytona sandbox Recursive made, including snapshots and warm start copies: once one has done no work for this long it is deleted, asleep or not. Sandboxes holding work not yet sent home are kept and shown in Computers settings.

schema.label: Cost per stopped sandbox hour (USD)
schema.description: Used to estimate what sleeping or stopped Daytona sandboxes cost. Empty counts them at the full hourly cost, because a stopped sandbox still bills for its disk.
